title: Application of a binary pressure sensitive paint for airfoils in subsonic flow
author: Henrique Fanini Leite
abstract: Following the introduction of a lifetime-based Pressure-Sensitive Paint system at IAE some years ago, there was an effort to expand the institute's capabilities to higher precision applications, such as low speed tests. In view of this, an updated, Binary-Paint based PSP was set up and validated through the analisys of flow patterns around a NACA 0012 airfoil in various conditions. In order to establish a comparison base and assess improvements brought about by the new approach, the same experiments were conducted using the lifetime-based system as well. Finally, a series of paint calibrations were performed to validate the manufacturer provided one and understand the influence of this factor on pressure field results.
